claims.summary: Low-hole linear transfer: over any field, on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) with any number of pigeons and N holes, for D <= ceil(N/2) and K + 1 <= D, a set F of polynomials of degree <= 1 whose edges lie in a set L of holes and on a set P of pigeons with N - |L| >= max(2K - 1, K + 1 + min(K, |P| - 1)) has its common kernel in V_K modulo the degree-D closure C equal to its common kernel modulo the hole and functionality closure H plus C cap V_K; in particular N - |L| >= 2K + 1 suffices for every P, and max(2K - 1, K + 2) for edges on two pigeons. Proof: lem:polynomial-numbering-transfer with L's holes ranked lowest and P's pigeons last; for an edge (p, j) and a matching t with a dance, p moves at its turn to a hole above j holding no pigeon and no target of t's dance (at most K + min(K, |P| - 1) excluded), and the one pigeon of t targeting j, if it moves before p, is re-targeted (at most 2K - 1 excluded). With an arbitrary pigeon order the construction needs 2K + 1, exactly. At K = 1 it contains cor:linear-error-transfer's in-particular clause.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer; its pigeons-last room is the reviewer's suggestion, its count and exactness checked in the reviewer's follow-up.
claims.rationale: Extends the K = 1 linear transfer to every K, so linear errors with edges in few holes, and sets of them, carry no closure killer beyond their representatives.
claims.next_action: The re-target bound 2K - 1 at K >= 4, by an augmenting-chain dance.

claims.summary: Partition transfer at every K: on the functional pigeonhole system over any field, with two distinct pigeons 1, 2 among any number, N holes, D <= ceil(N/2), 1 <= K <= D - 1 and rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2): if N - |A| >= rho, Ann_C(E_A) cap V_K = Ann_H(E_A + Q_2) cap V_K + C cap V_K, and if |A| >= rho the same with E_A + Q_1, so the single excess of E_A is 0; for partition errors E_{A_1}..E_{A_r} with representatives R_i = E_{A_i} + Q_2 or + Q_1 (edges in L_i = A_i or its complement) and N - |L_1 cup ... cup L_r| >= rho, the common kernel modulo C is the intersection of the Ann_H(R_i) cap V_K plus C cap V_K, so dim J = a, a the largest over choices of one representative per error of their domain common kernel plus C cap V_K. At the top degree D = ceil(N/2) = K + 1 with N <= 8, every E_A with |A| <= floor(N/2) - 1 or |A| >= ceil(N/2) + 1 has single excess 0. Proof: E_A - (E_A + Q_2) is a pigeon axiom, and lem:low-hole-linear-transfer with P = {1, 2}.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (pair remark, top-degree labels, the a <= dim J step); its top-degree reading and board checks at n = 3 to 6 confirmed in a follow-up.
claims.rationale: Proves the single-error side of the window comparison at every K for partition errors away from the middle, dim J = a for sets of them with few holes in all, and the only-if direction of conj:partition-excess-middle at n <= 8.
claims.next_action: The remaining pair orbits at seven pigeons with a zero-excess member, outside its range there.

claims.summary: Refutation of conj:partition-excess-middle at n = 1 and n = 2: over every field, on the functional pigeonhole system with n + 1 pigeons and n holes, D = ceil(n/2) = 1, K = 0, the closure C is the span of the pigeon axioms and C cap V_0 = 0; at n = 1 the middle size |A| = 0 has E_A = 1 - Q_2 and closure kernel 0, at n = 2 the middle size |A| = 1 has E_A + Q_2 = 1 + x_1a - x_2a, and c(1 + x_1a - x_2a) in span{Q_i} forces c = 0 by the coefficients of the variables at the other hole; so both have single excess 0, where the conjecture asserts it positive.
claims.assessment: Refutation found by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer; its direct proof checked in a third pass, one hole label corrected.
claims.rationale: Removes the conjecture's two smallest boards, outside its evidence.

claims.summary: Conjecture (middle excess from three holes): over F_2, on the functional pigeonhole system with n + 1 pigeons and n holes, n >= 3, at D = ceil(n/2), K = D - 1, the partition error E_A has positive single excess (closure kernel above every linear representative's domain side plus C cap V_K) exactly when |A| is floor(n/2) or ceil(n/2). Evidence: check:top-degree-partition-kernels and check:partition-sizes-seven-pigeons (n = 3 to 6); its only-if direction is proved at n <= 8 over every field by cor:partition-transfer-every-k. conj:partition-excess-middle without n >= 3, refuted at n = 1, 2 by ex:middle-excess-small-boards.
claims.assessment: Conjecture from exact F_2 computations at n = 3 to 6; its only-if direction proved at n <= 8 by cor:partition-transfer-every-k.
claims.rationale: The middle-size conjecture in the range of its evidence.
claims.next_action: The if direction at n = 7 and 8, by computation or a proof of a kernel beyond representatives at the middle.
